s.t:
We are seeking a highly strategic and deeply technical Vice President to own product strategy for one of the most transformative businesses within ServiceNow's AI Platform group: AI Application Development. This VP will lead a team of senior product managers and serve as a strategic partner to the SVP of AI Platform.
The ServiceNow developer platform is not a supporting capability; it is a critical growth lever of the company, and its mission is as follows: Empower builders and developers to discover, build, deploy, and govern enterprise AI Applications that reason about and automate complex and bespoke business processes.

This is intelligent, AI-powered application development, enabling every enterprise to discover and compose AI applications that learn from data, make decisions, and handle complex workflows with limited human intervention.

The more builders and developers (human and agent alike) who build on ServiceNow, the deeper ServiceNow's operational footprint becomes across the enterprise.
The market is signaling that vibe coding, AI-assisted development, and agentic application building are capturing developer imagination at a pace we have not seen in a decade.

Enterprises are actively searching for a trusted platform to standardize on, and ServiceNow, with 20+ years of enterprise process depth, a governed data layer, and Action Fabric as the execution runtime, is uniquely positioned to win that category.

This is the moment to make ServiceNow the home for every builder, and we need a visionary leader to seize it.
What you get to do in this role
Define and own the multi-year product vision. Set the strategic direction for how enterprises discover, build, deploy, and govern AI applications on ServiceNow. Translate market signals, competitive dynamics, and customer feedback into a product vision that spans the full developer surface area, from professional engineers to low-code builders, and define the multi-year roadmap the organization executes against.
Own go-to-market strategy and developer adoption. Define positioning, packaging, and adoption strategy for the AI Application Development Platform. Partner with sales, GTM, and partner teams to drive customer acquisition and expansion. Set adoption metrics (developer velocity, application deployment rates, time-to-value) and own the developer ecosystem story, including how ServiceNow attracts and retains builders across the enterprise.
Translate the frontier of AI development into platform primitives. Stay at the leading edge of vibe coding, AI-assisted development, and agentic application building. Understand where developer tooling, LLM-assisted workflows, and open-source ecosystems are heading, and translate those patterns into scalable, enterprise-grade platform capabilities that compound ServiceNow's developer advantage over time.
Lead and grow a world-class product organization. Build, develop, and retain a high-performing team of senior product managers. Establish PM discipline, culture, and operating rigor that emphasizes technical depth, customer empathy, and rigorous prioritization. Develop the next generation of product leaders and create an organization that is a competitive differentiator in talent.
Drive cross-functional alignment at the executive level. Serve as the central product voice for the platform across engineering, design, and go-to-market. Influence architecture and product direction across multiple teams and organizations. Make hard prioritization and tradeoff decisions and communicate them with clarity and confidence to VP+ and C-suite stakeholders.

s.h: To be successful in this role, you will have
s.t:
CRITICAL: Demonstrated track record of defining and executing platform or developer experience strategy at enterprise scale, including shipping 0 to 1 and scaling 1 to N products that drove significant customer adoption and measurable business outcomes. You have deep experience building and scaling a developer community and/or partner ecosystem.
Deep technical fluency. You understand developer platforms, low-code/no-code builders, API-first architectures, and modern AI development patterns. You can evaluate architectural tradeoffs, engage credibly with engineering leadership on technical decisions, and translate complex systems into clear product strategy. Prior experience as a software engineer or technical architect is a strong plus.
Fluency with agentic AI and the evolving developer landscape. You follow the frontier of AI-assisted development, vibe coding, and agentic application building. You understand where the market is heading and can convert fast-moving research and ecosystem signals into enterprise-grade product capabilities.
15+ years of product management experience, with at least 5+ years leading and scaling LARGE product organizations. You have built and developed PM teams and have a track record of attracting, retaining, and developing world-class product talent.
GTM strategy and adoption leadership. Experience defining positioning, pricing strategy, and adoption programs that drive customer acquisition and expansion at scale. You have owned the developer or platform adoption narrative and the partnerships that support it.
Data-driven decision making. You define metrics before launches, track them consistently, and use data to challenge your own assumptions as readily as those of others. You make directional calls with incomplete information and course-correct quickly.
For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $291,500 - $495,600 , plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure.

Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location.

We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.
Work Personas
We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here . To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.
Equal Opportunity Employer
ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.
Discord empowers people to create spaces where they can find a sense of belonging in their lives. Millions of people trust Discord to keep their communications secure, private, and out of the hands of evildoers, so security and privacy are necessary to Discord's success.
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Application Security team and protect Discord’s users where it matters most, their accounts. If you are an engineer with a wealth of experience making the secure way the easy way, a deep sense of curiosity, and an endless desire to improve Discord, read on!

Join an engineering team designing and implementing full-stack, user-facing security solutions that protect hundreds of millions of Discord users.
Lead full-stack work to strengthen session security and authentication for Discord’s users.
Improve, operate, and maintain security-critical authentication services, owning their correctness and security.
Partner with Product teams to drive adoption of stronger authentication and to ship user-facing account security tools.
Identify and design solutions for emerging threats to user account security.
Research and implement new security capabilities for the Discord platform, staying current on the authentication and session security landscape.
Build security controls and tools that emphasize self-service, automation, and performance to help identify and mitigate account security flaws.

You have 5+ years of experience securing production applications.
You have 3+ years of experience programming in at least one general-purpose programming language (e.g., Python, Go, Java, or Rust).
You have hands-on experience building and shipping production software, including security features, controls, frameworks, or guardrails.
You have hands-on experience with authentication and account security, such as WebAuthn, passkeys, FIDO2, MFA, and session management.
You are comfortable reasoning about the security of complex systems, even if they contain components you aren’t familiar with, and can give engineers clear, sound guidance on secure design and implementation.
You have experience leading security projects with a cross-functional group.
You have experience building or hardening client applications, such as desktop or native mobile apps.
You have experience operating in cloud-based environments (we use Google Cloud, but experience with other platforms is okay too).

Experience programming in at least one systems programming language (e.g. C, C++).
Experience developing, operating, and debugging production systems.
Familiarity with common application vulnerabilities on the platforms Discord ships on (that's all of them).
Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area (Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano, and Sonoma counties). Relocation assistance may be available.
The US base salary range for this full-time position is $196,000 to $245,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.
Why Discord?
Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!
Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know.
Please see our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy for details regarding Discord’s collection and usage of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking HERE.

Who We Are
Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.
We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.
You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

As a member of our Business Systems Engineering team, you will build or improve tools that are used daily by Go to Market teams. Our goal is to find bottlenecks and friction points, and drive process improvements as well as come up with technical solutions. Our team is the custodian of data that is used by sales, order, finance, support teams. We emphasize automation over operation, metrics over anecdotes, iteration over perfection and being proactive over responsive.
We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires you to be onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

Design and implement technical solutions that will span between AWS, Salesforce and NetSuite
Improve systems observability and invest in reliability & correctness of data
Develop customer empathy to propose improvements to systems
Lead projects from ideation to release
Help and mentor junior engineers

5+ years of software engineering with a focus on distributed systems at scale
Shipped customer facing products or internal tools in the past
Flexible and adaptive in a fast-paced startup environment
Passion for observability and reliability
In-depth expertise in distributed systems and data processing
AWS Cloud experience touching foundational blocks like: Kubernetes, Fargate, Lambda, Airflow, Athena, DynamoDB, VPC, and EC2.
Bonus: Experience with data infrastructure and data analytics

About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.
We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

We are looking for Mobile developer to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Finance Agent.
This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.
What You'll Own
Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.
Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.
Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.
Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.
Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.
Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.
Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.
Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.
Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.
Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.
Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.
Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.
App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.
Tech Stack
Kotlin
Jetpack Compose
Android SDK
Coroutines & Flow
SQL / NoSQL
TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)
The Kind of Builder We Want
Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.
Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.
Moves fast without creating messy code.
Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.
Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.
This Role Is Not For
Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.
Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.
People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.
Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.
People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.
Location
This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Grafana Labs , the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale.

With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions.

Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost.

We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in Spain, Sweden, UK, Ireland or Germany.

Software Engineer - Synthetic Monitoring The Opportunity: The Synthetic Monitoring squad builds and operates Grafana Cloud Synthetic Monitoring, used by teams globally to proactively verify that their critical user journeys, APIs, and services work as expected - before their customers notice they don't.

Synthetic Monitoring is a multi-tenant distributed system implemented in Go, running on Kubernetes across all major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), executing billions of synthetic tests each month from probe locations around the world and from customer-operated private probes.

The product is in a scale phase, and our focus is on making Synthetic Monitoring a deeply integrated part of Grafana Cloud: connecting checks to real user experience and cross-product investigation workflows, making check results a trusted signal for AI-assisted workflows, and enabling large organizations to operate the product at enterprise scale on our infrastructure and on their own private probes.

The role is full-stack in the real sense: the same engineer who designs how a check execution flows through scheduling, probes, and the telemetry pipeline should also be able to build the workflow that lets a user understand and act on the result.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software.

We are looking for Software Engineers who are passionate about building reliable systems and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Our stack is Golang, Typescript and React, but we build tools for people using many other stacks.

What you'll be doing: As a Software Engineer on the Synthetic Monitoring squad, you will work across the whole system - Go services and agents on the backend, a TypeScript/React application on the frontend and you'll be expected to reason about it as one system, not two halves. Specifically, you will:

Own features end-to-end across the stack : from API and data model design in Go, through the execution pipeline, to the user-facing workflows in TypeScript/React

Design and evolve systems, not just features : contribute to architectural decisions on scheduling, probe lifecycle, telemetry ingestion, and API design that shape how the product scales

Build the cross-product and AI-assisted workflows that connect Synthetic Monitoring to the wider Grafana Cloud platform

Make the product operable at enterprise scale : the governance and organization primitives that let teams with hundreds of checks manage Synthetic Monitoring as code and with confidence

Break down complex, ambiguous problems into incremental deliverables and iterate quickly based on feedback

Ensure quality through testing, observability of your own systems, and documentation : our checks are something customers alert on, so reliability is a feature

Be a part of the team's on-call rotation and take ownership of the services you're running
We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. Technologies you'll work with:
Go (backend services, APIs, and the synthetic monitoring agent)
TypeScript / React (the Synthetic Monitoring app in Grafana)
Kubernetes across AWS, GCP, and Azure
k6 (the execution engine behind scripted and browser checks)
Grafana ecosystem (Mimir, Loki, Prometheus)

s.h: What Makes You a Great Fit
s.t:
You are comfortable working in a remote-first company ; communication is key.
For us, working together means being collaborative, friendly, kind, and respectful . We operate by consensus. You can contribute to a discussion, disagree constructively, and commit to the team's decision. You are able to communicate design decisions clearly in written and spoken English.

Strong Go, or a path to it. We build Synthetic Monitoring in Go. Deep experience building and operating production backend systems in another systems language (Rust, Java, C++) translates well; backend experience limited to JavaScript/Node.js runtimes does not.

Operational mindset. You've run what you've built: you've owned production services, understand what it means to carry a pager, and treat reliability and toil reduction as part of the product.
You are a systems thinker : you reason about how components interact - data flow, failure modes, cost, and operational behavior - not just how a single feature works in isolation.

Pragmatism and short feedback loops. You break complex problems into increments: analyze, design, deliver an MVP, learn, iterate. You are able to design a solution, get feedback, and write a prototype by yourself - the ability to work on your own is crucial.
You have a good understanding of a software development process that takes a user-centered approach . You easily build an understanding of the users' context and goals which will help you build the right solution with the maximum value.
You use AI tools as a natural part of your engineering workflow - whether for accelerating exploration, code review, or reasoning through design tradeoffs - and you're thoughtful about where they help and where they don't.

About the Role We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer in Mexico City who thrives on solving complex problems, building high-quality software, and taking ownership from idea to production.

At Kojo, engineers don't simply implement tickets, they partner closely with Product, Design, and Customer teams to define solutions, make technical decisions, and deliver meaningful customer impact.

This is a role for someone who enjoys working across the stack, embraces ambiguity, and wants to help shape both our product and our engineering culture. What You'll Do Build
Design, build, and operate reliable, scalable, and maintainable software.
Own features and systems from technical design through production.
Improve system performance, reliability, and developer experience.
Continuously raise the quality of our codebase through thoughtful engineering practices.
Technical Leadership
Lead complex technical initiatives from ambiguous problem to successful delivery.
Make architectural decisions by balancing short-term execution with long-term sustainability.
Drive technical discussions and help establish engineering best practices.
Mentor engineers through code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance.
Collaboration
Partner closely with Product, Design, Customer Success, and fellow engineers to solve customer problems.
Contribute to engineering and product roadmap discussions.
Collaborate across teams as priorities evolve.
Ownership
Take responsibility for production systems and customer outcomes.
Identify opportunities to improve our systems, tooling, and engineering processes.
Own problems, not just tickets, and help create clarity in ambiguous situations.
What You've Accomplished We're more interested in the impact you've had than the number of years you've worked. We're excited to meet candidates who have:
Significant experience designing, building, and shipping high-quality production software.
Strong software engineering fundamentals and an understanding of systems from application code through infrastructure.
Experience taking products or major features from concept to production.
Led technical projects involving multiple engineers and stakeholders.
Made architectural decisions and can clearly explain the trade-offs behind them.
Strong backend engineering experience, including APIs (REST and/or GraphQL), databases (PostgreSQL or similar), authentication, and distributed systems concepts.
Experience working across modern web technologies and willingness to contribute across the stack when needed.
Experience with technologies similar to ours. Our stack includes TypeScript, Node.js, React, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and AWS, but we care far more about strong engineering fundamentals than prior experience with any specific framework.

s.h: Nice to Have Experience with one or more of the following
s.t:
AWS services (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda)
Docker
Elasticsearch
Observability tools such as Datadog or Sentry
What Success Looks Like Successful Senior Software Engineers at Kojo:
Own problems, not just tickets.
Turn ambiguous problems into simple, maintainable solutions.
Deliver consistently while maintaining a high quality bar.
Know when to move quickly and when to invest in long-term engineering quality.
Help other engineers succeed through collaboration and mentorship.
Leave systems and codebases better than they found them.
Continuously improve how we build software, not just what we build.
What You Care About
Customer Obsession : You care deeply about solving real customer problems and delivering meaningful value.
Ownership : You take responsibility for outcomes, proactively identify opportunities for improvement, and follow through.
Craftsmanship : You value clean, maintainable software and thoughtful technical decisions.
Pragmatism : You balance speed with quality and know how to make thoughtful trade-offs.
Growth : You actively seek feedback, continuously learn, and help those around you grow.
How We Use AI AI is part of how we build at Kojo. Engineers are expected to thoughtfully incorporate AI tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar into their daily workflow whenever they meaningfully improve productivity and software quality.

We use AI for tasks like scaffolding, debugging, documentation, testing, and accelerating repetitive work, but AI never replaces engineering judgment. You remain accountable for the architecture, trade-offs, correctness, security, and quality of everything that ships. AI is a force multiplier for great engineers, not a substitute for them.

Unsere Projekte entstehen unter anderem in Zusammenarbeit mit Hochschulen, Museen, Bildungseinrichtungen, Kommunen und Industrieunternehmen. Dabei verbinden wir neue Technologien mit konkreten Anwendungen in Bildung, Forschung, Kultur und Industrie.
Für ein interdisziplinäres Entwicklungsprojekt in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Makerspace der Ruhr-Universität Bochum suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen AI Application Developer mit Erfahrung im Bereich technisches Projektmanagement (m/w/d).
Aufgaben
Die Stelle

Hi, I'm Erik, CTO of Circonomit. This ad is specific on purpose: you should be able to tell from it whether this is your job.
We build decision infrastructure for industrial companies: our customers model their production — capacities, costs, constraints — and we compute the answer to "what should we do?" before the decision is made.
Your mission: scale our data platform for multiple customers and domains. Customer data arrives in many formats from many sources, ERP exports included; it has to land in our system consistently, stay manageable at millions of records, and be fast to query when models and results are on screen.

The product is a data-heavy web app with a math-heavy backend (Python, TypeScript, Solid.js, Postgres, on Cloudflare): your center of gravity is data and infrastructure, but you touch the whole stack. We are looking for a system thinker who wants to shape the architecture, and more than that.
We will not sugarcoat it: short deadlines, real workload, and a platform that grows while customers already run on it.
What you'll own
The data platform end to end: ingestion, storage, and the query paths that keep millions of records fast on screen. You design it, you build it, you run it in production.
The platform layer, directly with the CTO: infrastructure, deployments, and the path to production for the whole team.
Performance and correctness work in the optimization engine, together with our research engineers.
Your features from first line to production: nobody hands you a ticket and waits.
How we work
Small team, short lines of communication, no layers. You own your features end to end: you build them, you ship them to production yourself, you run them.
Feedback runs both ways and it runs continuously, in daily work and in weekly one-on-ones. We talk as equals. We communicate proactively and flag it early when something isn't working out. Saying no is part of the job.
We like this work, and you'll notice. The energy of a small team that cares is what people remember about being here. We review each other's code, and we like being together in the Cologne office, because the fastest conversations still happen in a room.

5+ years building production backend or data-intensive systems.
Strong Python and solid TypeScript, with the appetite to work in both daily.

Production PostgreSQL (multi-tenant, migrations, performance).

Distributed systems and API design: typical failure modes, HTTP/auth/caching, sane versioning and error behavior.
Engineering craft: design patterns, CI/CD pipelines you set up yourself, prototypes you can throw away.
You have worked in a team, not mostly alone, and you know from experience which agile practices carry their weight.
You have experience working with Linear, Jira, or a similar project management tool.
You communicate proactively, too much rather than too little, and you organize yourself and your work.
German at C1 or better, and fluent English. Team life runs in German; code and docs are English.

You are structured and biased for action, and you have shown you play to win wherever life has put you so far.

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched. Tables run every clinical trial, every financial model, every scientific experiment, every business decision, and no one had built a foundation model that truly understood them.
Until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables. The next modality shift in AI is happening, and we're hiring the team that makes it.
Momentum. We pioneered tabular foundation models and are now the world-leading organization in structured-data ML. Our TabPFN v2 model was published as a Nature cover story and set a new state of the art for tabular machine learning.

Since release we've scaled model capabilities 20x+, passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and are seeing accelerating adoption across research and industry - from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi to improving clinical-trial decisions with BostonGene .
The hardest work is ahead. We're scaling tabular foundation models to millions of rows, thousands of features, real-time inference, and entirely new data modalities, while building the infrastructure to run them in production across some of the most demanding industries on earth. These are open problems no one else is working on at this level.
Our team. We ship fast, do top-tier research, and hold each other to an extremely high bar.
What's next. In 2025 we raised €9m pre-seed led by Balderton Capital, backed by leaders from Hugging Face, DeepMind, and Black Forest Labs. The next phase of growth is here, which makes this an ideal time to join.

Leadership: Influence through code and design, not title — proven ability to drive cross-team technical decisions while staying in the critical path of delivery.
Education: BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

We are seeking a skilled engineer to join the Apertus post-training effort. The ideal candidate will develop, run, and evaluate the SFT and reinforcement learning pipelines used to turn Apertus base models into capable assistants. This role requires a strong background in LLM post-training, solid software engineering skills, and the ability to work collaboratively in a research-focused HPC environment.
Project background
We train open foundation models with hundreds of billions of parameters on thousands of GPUs on one of the largest AI-ready supercomputers in Europe. The team counts more than a dozen full-time engineers working alongside leading researchers from EPFL and ETH Zürich, has released the Apertus 1 and Apertus 1.5 models, and works with over thirty academic collaborators to deliver fully open (open source), responsibly trained, multilingual, multimodal AI models for research and industry.
Apertus is trained and developed on Alps, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre's supercomputing infrastructure. The role requires someone who is comfortable working in an HPC environment and collaborating with researchers and infrastructure engineers.
Job description
The engineer will contribute to the development, execution, and evaluation of scalable post-training workflows for Apertus.
Infrastructure and systems engineering
· Build and maintain containerised environments for LLM post-training and RL workloads
· Adapt containers and dependencies for execution on Alps / CSCS infrastructure
· Run and monitor Slurm-based training and evaluation jobs
· Debug failures related to distributed execution, checkpointing, filesystem performance, networking, and GPU utilisation
· Help maintain reproducible training recipes, configuration files, launch scripts, and documentation
· Work with researchers and CSCS engineers to improve the reliability and performance of large-scale experiments
LLM post-training and reinforcement learning
· Support SFT, preference optimisation, and reinforcement learning workflows
· Build and run RL environments for tasks with verifiable outcomes, such as mathematics, code, tool-use, and reasoning
· Implement and run reward modelling, reward calibration, and verifier-based training
· Generate and validate synthetic or gym training tasks
· Run ablation studies comparing algorithms, reward functions, data mixtures, hyperparameters, and infrastructure settings
· Evaluate model behaviour across reasoning, coding, mathematics, instruction-following, multilingual, tool-use, and safety benchmarks
· Debug common post-training issues, including optimisation instability, reward hacking, regressions, and evaluation failures
Profile
Essential
· MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field
· Exceptional BSc candidates with strong engineering experience will also be considered
· Experience in AI and neural network architectures
· Strong collaboration and communication skills and ability to work across research and engineering teams
· Prior hands-on experience in the core domains of this role is required
· This can be project or study based experience; formal work experience is preferred
· A high degree of flexibility: priorities, tools, and day-to-day tasks shift with training schedules, releases, and a fast-moving field
· Hands-on experience with LLM post-training, be it alignment (SFT, preference optimisation) or reinforcement learning
· This means experience with frameworks such as veRL, slime, Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, TRL, vLLM, SGLang, or similar tools

· Familiarity with distributed training concepts such as data parallelism, tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, checkpointing, and GPU communication
· Experience with Slurm or another HPC workload manager
· Experience building or adapting containers for HPC or GPU clusters

· Published research in the domains relevant to this role, or familiarity with recently published research on these topics
· Experience creating verifiable tasks for mathematics, code, reasoning, or tool use
· Familiarity with lower-level GPU/distributed libraries such as NCCL, Transformer Engine, FlashAttention, or communication backends
· Experience with large-scale evaluation pipelines

The Functional Genomics Center Zurich (FGCZ) is a joint state-of-the-art research and training facility of the ETH Zurich and the University of Zurich. With the latest technologies and key expertise for omics research, the FGCZ provides research services and project support to the Zurich life science research community.
We are looking for a Research Software Engineer at Functional Genomics Center Zurich as soon as possible or upon agreement.
Project background
This position is centered on mass spectrometry data, with a primary focus on bioinformatics analysis and interpretation in support of researchers at the FGCZ. Within that field, the team covers raw data processing, high-performance computing, statistical evaluation, interpretation, and integrated analysis.

The unit maintains a portfolio of commercial and open-source applications operating on our infrastructure and establishes novel data processing and analysis pipelines. An integral part of the work is integrating the data into our data management system and ensuring the reproducibility of the analysis.
Job description
· You will support the FGCZ proteomics and metabolomics user community by maintaining existing and developing new mass spectrometric data processing and analysis pipelines
· In this role, you will apply your expertise in informatics and data science to ensure the reproducibility of the data analysis performed
· As a member of the FGCZ bioinformatics group, you will have back-office and user-desk tasks to support our collaborators at ETH and the University of Zurich with data interpretation and bioinformatics projects
Profile

· Team player - working closely with wet-lab scientists and translating their needs into analysis
· Academic degree in any of the relevant areas, including (but not limited to) computer science, statistics, or biology
· A master’s degree in a relevant field; candidates with a Ph.D. are equally welcome to apply
· Proficiency in Microsoft Windows and Linux operating systems, including command-line interfaces
· Practical knowledge of at least one programming language (C++, C#, Java, Python) and tools such as Git
· Responsible and informed use of AI-assisted tools in a scientific context

· Familiarity with the management and analysis of large-scale datasets, in particular omics-related data
· Background in bioinformatics, ideally in mass spectrometry
· Experience in imaging, spatial, or cross-omics disciplines
· Proven track record of writing and maintaining code
· Experience in R/Bioconductor and client-side web programming
· Experience with UI/UX design, particularly the development of web-based or desktop interfaces for scientific data visualization
· Experience with virtualization tools, e.g., Docker, Apptainer
· Experience with resource managment software, e.g., Slurm
The ability to work independently is a prerequisite, as is the ability to interact effectively with the center's research and technical staff and external research groups in a team-oriented manner Advanced knowledge of English is essential, as this is the working language of the center.
We particularly encourage applications from early-career candidates eager to develop their skills in a stimulating research environment.

A highly interesting position at the intersection of technology and life science research. Employment conditions are according to the regulations of ETH Zurich and the University of Zurich. At VREY , we're building the EnergyOS for multi-family buildings .
Germany has over 3.3 million apartment buildings — and they are the blind spot of the energy transition. <1% solar penetration. <2% smart metering. Almost no flexibility or intelligent energy management.
At the same time, regulation is forcing property owners into major investment: solar is becoming mandatory, smart meters must be rolled out nationwide within five years, heating and mobility are electrifying. The apartment building is transforming from passive real estate into an active part of the decentralised energy infrastructure.
What's missing is an integrated system that makes this transition economically viable and operationally manageable.
VREY combines certified meter operation with proprietary software , enabling property owners to sell self-generated solar power directly to their tenants — simply, and without having to become an energy supplier themselves (§42b EnWG). Regulatory obligation becomes a profitable, predictable opportunity:
Double-digit returns and asset appreciation for owners,
~20% electricity cost savings for tenants, and
digital infrastructure for storage, heat pumps, and flexibility.
We already manage a three-digit number of projects — including some of Germany's largest property holders and housing cooperatives — in all 16 federal states. In the course of our seed financing, we raised €3.3M from leading impact and energy VCs (including Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, and Kopa Ventures). We're at the beginning of a structural market shift. Join us and help build the leading EnergyOS.

Was sind SolidFlow -Batterien?
SolidFlow -Batterien speichern Energie in organischen Molekülen. Der Verzicht auf explosive Materialien macht sie sicher, der Einsatz von sozial und ökologisch konfliktfreien Rohstoffen nachhaltig und die nahezu unbegrenzte Materialverfügbarkeit skalierbar und günstig in der Beschaffung. Das macht unsere patentierte SolidFlow - Technologie zu einem Gamechanger im Aufbau eines globalen klimaneutralen Energiesystems.
Vom Start-up zum Scale-up: Gemeinsam packen wir es an
CMBlu Energy entwickelt sich von einem Start-up mit Forschungsschwerpunkt zu einem produzierenden Scale-up, das sich auf dem Sprung in die Serienproduktion befindet. An diesem Ziel arbeiten rund 250 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter bei CMBlu Energy. Unser Hauptsitz ist in Alzenau nähe Frankfurt , mit einer Zwei g stelle in Obernburg. Hinzu kommen Tochtergesellschaften in Athen, Griechenland und Petaluma, USA.
Deine Mission
Möchtest du Software, Datenpipelines und KI bauen, die Batterieforschung schneller machen? Bei uns entwickelst du die Systeme, die aus unseren Forschungs-, Pilot- und Produktionsdaten bessere Materialien und Zellen machen – und die KI-Werkzeuge, mit denen unsere Chemie- und Elektrochemie-Teams jeden Tag arbeiten.
Du bist stark in der Software-Entwicklung, hast ein Faible für Daten und echten Bock auf KI in ihrer ganzen Breite – von LLMs und Agenten bis zu klassischem Machine Learning. Sauberes Engineering verbindest du mit Databricks, Azure und Claude zu Werkzeugen, die es so nicht von der Stange gibt.
Damit gibst du unserer Forschung nicht nur Daten, sondern Antworten – und den Hebel, schneller die richtigen Entscheidungen zu treffen.
Deine Aufgaben
Produktionsreife Software entwickeln – APIs, Services und interne Web-Apps in modernem Python (uv, FastAPI/uvicorn), mit sauberer Architektur, Tests und CI/CD; etwa Analyse-Apps, mit denen Forschende ihre Testdaten auswerten, als Databricks Apps über Asset Bundles und GitLab deployt.
KI-Anwendungen für die Forschung entwickeln – Assistenten und Agenten, die R&D bei Aufgaben wie Recherche, Hypothesenbildung, Materialauswahl und Syntheseplanung unterstützen. Du kombinierst LLMs und Agenten (u. a. Claude über MCP) mit wissenschaftlichen Methoden wie Cheminformatik, Retrosynthese und Quantenchemie – und treibst diese Werkzeuge kontinuierlich voran.
KI breit denken – nicht nur LLMs – klassisches Machine Learning dort einsetzen, wo es das bessere Werkzeug ist: Zusammenhänge zwischen Material und Performance modellieren, Datenqualität und Anomalien erkennen, Lebensdauer und Degradation vorhersagen.
Skalierbare Daten-Pipelines und unsere Datenplattform bauen und betreiben – nach dem Bronze/Silver/Gold-Prinzip auf Databricks und Azure, von der Sensor-Ingestion (MQTT, Event Hubs, Lakeflow) bis zu den Gold-Tabellen, mit denen die Fachbereiche direkt arbeiten.
Deine Systeme end-to-end verantworten – von der Datenquelle über Modell bzw. Agent bis zum Werkzeug in der Hand der Forschenden, inklusive Security, Observability, Qualität und Verlässlichkeit.
Eng mit Chemie, Elektrochemie, Engineering und Testing zusammenarbeiten und wissenschaftliche Fragestellungen in Software- und KI-Lösungen übersetzen.
Dein Profil
Du bist in erster Linie starke:r Entwickler:in – mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bau produktionsreifer Software, mit Gespür für Architektur, sauberem Code, Testing und CI/CD (idealerweise GitLab).
Du beherrschst Python sehr sicher (und SQL) und bist beim Entwurf von APIs, Services und Microservices zu Hause.
Du hast solide Data-Engineering-Erfahrung – Databricks und PySpark, die Medaillon-Architektur (Bronze/Silver/Gold), Batch- und Streaming-Pipelines sowie der Azure-Data-Stack (Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, Event Hubs).
Du hast echte Affinität zu KI in der ganzen Breite – praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs und generativer KI (RAG, Agenten, MCP, Tools wie Claude) und ein fundiertes Verständnis von klassischem Machine Learning – und du weißt, wann du was einsetzt.
Du willst an der Schnittstelle aus Software, Daten, KI und Naturwissenschaften arbeiten und bringst die Neugier mit, dich in unsere Domäne – Batterie, Chemie, Elektrochemie – einzudenken.

About CoLab At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner. CoLab is the AI platform for driving stronger engineering decisions.

Every design review in CoLab builds a knowledge repository of design feedback, decisions, and lessons learned - which AI agents draw from to flag issues on future designs before they compound. The more your team works in CoLab, the smarter it gets and the faster you arrive at the ideal design.

Companies like Ford, Komatsu, and Johnson Controls use CoLab to catch issues earlier, eliminate rework cycles, and bring products to market faster. Founded in St. John's, Newfoundland, CoLab has grown quickly from our first customer in 2019 to a rapidly scaling company.

We've recently been recognized on Deloitte's Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, and named a Canadian company to watch by The Globe and Mail and Financial Post. About the Role Modern engineering teams invest a significant amount of time and money on simulation.

Before anything gets built, teams need confidence that a design is going to work: structurally, thermally, aerodynamically, etc. Simulation is one of the main ways they build that confidence. But the way teams share and review simulation results to make decisions is still pretty broken.

Engineers are exporting videos, taking screenshots, dropping them into PowerPoint, and then trying to make decisions through email threads, meetings, or disconnected slide decks.

The actual decision-making ends up separated from the underlying simulation data, which means context gets lost, feedback is hard to trace, and important engineering knowledge disappears into the workflow. CoLab already helps engineering teams review CAD, capture feedback, and make better design decisions in one connected workspace.

Now we’re extending that same idea into simulation. The goal is simple: make simulation results collaborative, reviewable, and traceable in the same way CoLab does for CAD today. We’re starting a new product team focused on bringing simulation review into CoLab.

As one of the first engineers on that team, you’ll help define how simulation data gets ingested, visualized, discussed, and connected back to real engineering decisions.

There are a lot of interesting technical problems here: large datasets, high-performance visualization, viewer interactions, data pipelines, and user experiences that need to work for mechanical engineers doing critical product development work.

The first phase is about learning the product, the customers, and the review workflows we already support today. You’ll spend time embedded with our Engineering Reviews team, learning how engineers collaborate in CoLab, where the current product is strong, and where simulation creates a new set of problems we need to solve.

From there, you’ll help build the foundation for a new Simulation team - not just technically, but from a product perspective as well. We want to build something customers actually need and will use in their day-to-day work, and that requires a highly product oriented approach.

Our Ideal Candidate You're the kind of developer who wants to understand why a feature matters before deciding how to build it. You enjoy owning complex technical problems, but you also enjoy talking with product managers, designers, and customers to understand what success actually looks like.

You make thoughtful technical decisions independently and know when to bring others into the conversation. Experience working with simulation software is a significant advantage. Maybe you've worked with FEA, CFD, multiphysics simulations, scientific visualization, or engineering data platforms.

You understand the kinds of problems engineers are trying to solve. This is a good fit for someone who likes ambiguity, wants to work closely with our product and leadership teams, and cares about the connection between technical decisions and customer value.

You’ll have a meaningful role in shaping both the architecture and the user experience for a new capability that we think can become a major part of engineering review in CoLab. What You'll Do
Help design and build CoLab's next-generation simulation review capabilities.
Build services that ingest and process simulation data from industry-standard engineering software.
Develop high-performance visualization experiences capable of displaying large simulation datasets.
Partner closely with Product, Design, and customers to validate ideas before building them.
Spend time embedded with the Engineering Reviews team to develop deep product and customer understanding before transitioning onto the Simulation team.
Contribute to architectural decisions that will shape this product area for years to come.
Improve performance, scalability, and reliability as simulation capabilities grow.
Collaborate with engineers across the platform to ensure simulation becomes a seamless part of the broader CoLab experience.

AI Enablement is the team that builds the AI infrastructure the rest of Clara's engineering org runs on. We're not a team that "adds AI to a product" — we build the tools other teams build with.

Live examples today: Clara Builders (an internal skills marketplace and self-service app platform), an agent that turns Figma designs directly into production code through MCP, a documentation agent that keeps internal knowledge in sync with the codebases it describes, and n8n automations already running in production across several business teams.
We're looking for a senior engineer to own the frontend architecture of Clara Builders and go deep on the systems behind it — backend services, agent infrastructure, and the AI tooling other teams across Clara rely on. This is deliberately not a frontend-only role: you'll be expected to move into backend and infra whenever the problem calls for it, and to build AI tooling yourself rather than just apply it to your own tickets.
Concretely, Clara Builders is a Next.js 15 (App Router) + TypeScript app on Prisma/Postgres, with a self-service Dokploy deploy pipeline (staging → beta → production, gated by a pending/approved environment lifecycle) and a Cloudflare AI Gateway layer that proxies multiple LLM providers behind one internal endpoint.
